author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v1.0.4: fixes the strobe (strobe bit and payload field order), siren now uses the burglar warning mode, strobe-only command, new Health Check Siren/Strobe commands, alarm/switch reset when the duration ends, WarningDevice-EF-3.0 fingerprint, lastCheckin, and commands from installed()/updated() are now actually sent. maxDuration is limited to 1..600 s. Parts derived from gabriele-v's driver (Apache 2.0).

x-catalog.description: Zigbee driver for the Heiman HS2WD-E siren: alarm, strobe and tone control.
